result.reason: The clause does not reach the preferred position and does not clearly reach the fallback. The cap is limited to amounts actually paid, rather than fees paid or payable or the greater-of USD 1,000,000 formulation. It lacks express carve-outs for indemnification, data protection/security, and fraud; Section 8 cannot be assumed to cover indemnification. It also unnecessarily introduces a three-times-annual-fees support super-cap and customer-credit pass-through damages, materially altering unrelated risk allocation. Payment obligations are broadly uncapped rather than clarifying only that Customer payment obligations are not damages. The duplicated, fragmentary paragraph and undefined 'annual fees' further undermine drafting quality.
